summary: SCAQMD Rule 222 is potentially relevant only if the coating shop is in South Coast AQMD jurisdiction and the coating/paint operation is one of the specified emission sources eligible for filing/registration rather than a written permit. The official SCAQMD Rule 222 PDF is titled “Rule 222 Filing Requirements for Specific Emission Sources Not Requiring a Written Permit Pursuant to Regulation II,” but the project record lacks a resolved county/location and lacks coating/material throughput or VOC/HAP details needed to match a Rule 222 category. Therefore, do not conclude Rule 222 registration applies based only on “coating booth” and 60 gallons of solvent storage; treat H-AIR-222 as indeterminate/potentially applicable pending jurisdiction confirmation and equipment/material details.
title: H-AIR-222 — SCAQMD Rule 222 registration applicability for coating booth cannot be confirmed without location and coating details
